_This page is generated from src/project.ts, so it says what the tool does._

An optional `skill-evals.config.json` in the project root sets defaults. A flag wins over the file.

| Key                    | Type     | Default of                          | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cases`                | string   | `--cases <dir>`                     | The directory that holds the cases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `harness`              | string   | `--harness <ids\|all>`              | Comma-separated harness ids.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `reps`                 | number   | `--reps <n>`                        | Runs for each subject and case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `jobs`                 | number   | `--jobs <n>`                        | How many runs may be in flight at once. A positive integer. Each run has its own home, workspace and copy of the subject. results.json lists the records in plan order whatever order the runs end in; results.jsonl and the progress lines follow the order they end in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `retries`              | number   | `--retries <n>`                     | Tries after the first for a run that failed for a reason that is not the agent's: a harness crash (a non-zero exit with no final event), a rate limit (the adapter says so), or a timeout before the harness produced any agent event (its opening init event does not count). A non-negative integer. A rate-limited run waits 30 seconds times its attempt number first. A setup failure, an isolation breach, any other invalid run and a low score are never retried. The run record's attempts lists the error, cost (null when none was reported) and duration of each earlier attempt. |
| `maxCost`              | number   | `--max-cost <usd>`                  | Stop starting runs once this command has spent this many US dollars, summing agent, judge and decision costs over the attempts it made; reused runs are not counted. A positive number. Runs in flight finish, with their judged and decision checks skipped, so they are invalid and --resume repeats them. The command exits 4. A usage error when a selected harness, the judge or a decision check reports no cost.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `maxDuration`          | number   | `--max-duration <minutes>`          | Stop starting runs after this many minutes of wall time. A positive number; fractions are allowed. Runs in flight finish, with their judged and decision checks skipped. The command exits 4.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `model`                | string   | `--model <id>`                      | Passed to the harness unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `judgeHarness`         | string   | `--judge-harness <id>`              | The harness that scores judged checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `judgeModel`           | string   | `--judge-model <id>`                | The model that scores judged checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `judgeApi`             | string   | `--judge-api <kind>`                | Ask the judge model over this API and start no harness process for it. Only anthropic. --judge-harness is then ignored.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `judgeUrl`             | string   | `--judge-url <url>`                 | The base URL of the judge API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `judgeKeyVar`          | string   | none                                | The variable that holds the key of the judge API. The agent under test never gets it, unless it is one of that harness's own login variables. Default: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `judgeTimeout`         | number   | none                                | The seconds one request to the judge API may take. A positive integer. A timeout counts as a failed attempt. Default: 120.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `judgeFallbacks`       | boolean  | none                                | Ask the judge API to fall back when the model refuses: the `anthropic-beta` header and `fallbacks: "default"` in the request. Set it to `false` for a proxy that rejects them. Default: `true`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `decisionModel`        | string   | `--decision-model <id>`             | The decision model that scores decision checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `decisionUrl`          | string   | `--decision-url <url>`              | The base URL of the decision model's API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `decisionTimeout`      | number   | `--decision-timeout <seconds>`      | How long one request to the decision model may take. A positive integer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `minScore`             | number   | `--min-score <0..1>`                | The lowest suite score that passes. The command exits 1 when the suite score of the subject (B for run) is lower.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `minDelta`             | number   | `--min-delta <-1..1>`               | The least score difference, B minus A, that the suite must show, on the suite delta and not on its interval. The command exits 1 when the delta is lower. A negative number lets B score lower by at most that much. A case's own minDelta is the same bar for that case. Only run compares two subjects: with score it is a usage error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `noise`                | string   | `--noise <file>`                    | A noise.json that calibrate wrote. A delta that is no larger than the noise it records for its case, or for the suite, reads "within noise", whatever its interval. A case that the file does not list is judged by its interval alone, and the report says so. A file of the wrong shape is a usage error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `seed`                 | number   | `--seed <n>`                        | The seed of the bootstrap behind every interval, a positive integer up to 4294967295. The same runs and the same seed give the same report, byte for byte. results.json records it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `maxInvalid`           | number   | `--max-invalid <fraction>`          | The share of the planned runs that may be invalid, from 0 to 1. The command exits 3 only when the invalid runs divided by the planned runs of the cases that apply are greater than this. A run that did not run because --max-cost or --max-duration stopped the command is not invalid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `report`               | string[] | `--report <formats>`                | The report formats to write: md, json, junit or html. Repeat the flag or separate formats with commas. md goes to standard output, and only when it is listed. The others go to report.json, report.xml (JUnit) and report.html in the output directory. summary.json is always written there.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `maxJudgedWeightShare` | number   | none                                | The share of a case's total check weight, from 0 to 1, that `judge` and `decision` checks may carry before `validate` warns. Default: 0.5.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `lenient`              | boolean  | `--lenient`                         | Drop a key that a case file does not take, and warn, instead of failing. Keys that start with x- are always kept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `isolated`             | boolean  | `--isolated`                        | Start the harness with nothing loaded but the subject, and mark a run invalid when the harness reports anything else as loaded. Only harnesses that declare the isolated capability take it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `historyMode`          | string   | `--history-mode <native\|preamble>` | How a case's history.json reaches the agent. preamble renders it as a block in front of the first message, which every harness can do. native writes it as the harness's own session and resumes it, and only a harness that declares historyNative can: where it is forced on one that cannot, a case with a history is not applicable. Each run record keeps the mode. Results of the two modes are not comparable.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `keepWorkspaces`       | boolean  | `--keep-workspaces`                 | After a run's checks, archive its workspace, the seed it started from, its remote directory and its throwaway home as <run>.workspace.tar in the output directory, with the system tar. The harness's login files are left out of the home, and the grader's copy is never in it. results.json records each archive as workspaceArchive. rejudge reads the archive to score the checks that need files again. Needs tar on PATH.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `env`                  | string[] | none                                | Names of environment variables the harness gets besides the allowlist. An exact variable name: not empty, without `=`, not `_`, and not starting with `SKILL_EVALS_` or `npm_`. Anything else is an error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `subjectExclude`       | string[] | none                                | Globs, relative to the subject, of paths that a run never gets: they are left out of its copy, besides `.git`, `node_modules`, the cases directory and the output directory. `*` matches within one directory, `**` matches any depth, `?` one character, and `{a,b}` either. See [Subjects](../concepts/subjects.md).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

Every key is optional. `cases` resolves against the project root. `harness` narrows `check` too. An unknown key, a value of the wrong type, or invalid JSON is an error with exit code 2.

A file that sets every key. It shows each key's type, and is not a file to run with: `maxCost` is a usage error when a selected case has a decision check, which reports no cost, and when the judge is the API (`judgeApi`). The decision model alone is fine: it is only used when a case has a decision check.

```json
{
  "cases": "evals/cases",
  "harness": "claude-code",
  "reps": 3,
  "jobs": 4,
  "retries": 1,
  "maxCost": 25,
  "maxDuration": 90,
  "model": "<model-id>",
  "judgeHarness": "claude-code",
  "judgeModel": "<model-id>",
  "judgeApi": "anthropic",
  "judgeUrl": "<base-url>",
  "judgeKeyVar": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  "judgeTimeout": 120,
  "judgeFallbacks": true,
  "decisionModel": "<decision-model-id>",
  "decisionUrl": "<base-url>",
  "decisionTimeout": 60,
  "minScore": 0.8,
  "minDelta": 0.05,
  "noise": "results/noise.json",
  "seed": 1,
  "maxInvalid": 0.1,
  "report": ["md", "json"],
  "maxJudgedWeightShare": 0.5,
  "lenient": false,
  "isolated": false,
  "historyMode": "preamble",
  "keepWorkspaces": false,
  "env": ["AWS_ENDPOINT_URL"],
  "subjectExclude": ["evals/cases/**", "notes/**"]
}
```

## JSON Schemas

The package ships a JSON Schema for the config file and one for `case.json`, so that an editor can check a file as you type and offer its keys. They are JSON Schema 2020-12, and they are written from the same tables as this page and [Checks](checks.md), so they cannot drift from what the tool accepts. Point an editor at one with a `$schema` key, which the tool allows, and ignores, in both files and which must be a string:

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/skill-evals/schema/config.schema.json",
  "reps": 3
}
```

In a `case.json`, use `schema/case.schema.json` of the same package, with a path relative to the case file, such as `../../../node_modules/skill-evals/schema/case.schema.json`. The `$id` of each schema is under `https://phillipchaffee.github.io/skill-evals/schema/`.

The schemas check what one value can show. They do not check that a decision check has exactly one of `expect` and `options`, that a regular expression compiles, that a variant id is unique within its case, that a variant's `promptAppend` has a `prompt.md` with text to append to, that a case has a prompt source, that a `prompt` or `promptAppend` is more than whitespace, that `flags` is a valid set of flags, that an `options` answer has a name, or that a case directory name has no `@` or `,`, so a file can pass the schema and still fail to load. A weight of `null` passes, because the loader takes it as no weight. `skill-evals list` checks the rest.
